headline: Rutschman fuels offense as the Red Sox dismantle the Diamondbacks again
morning_brew: That is how you capitalize on a win. The Red Sox stayed locked in against Arizona last night, cruising to a 9-4 victory that keeps the energy at Fenway Park exactly where we need it. Seeing Adley Rutschman connect for his first home run in our uniform was the absolute highlight of the night, and it felt like the entire lineup was just waiting for a spark like that to kick down the doors. We are finally stringing quality at-bats together instead of waiting around for a miracle in the late innings, which is a nice change of pace for my blood pressure.

Ranger Suarez gave us the kind of start we have been desperate for, battling through his outing and handing the lead over to the relievers with a comfortable cushion. The arms out of the bullpen were rock solid, shutting down any potential rallies and making sure we never felt that familiar late-game panic. It is refreshing to watch the team play with this much confidence, especially after the way we looked just a few days ago when I was ready to throw my remote through the drywall.

My neighbor Rick is holding off on his usual umpire dossier today, probably because even he cannot find a single thing to complain about after a performance like that. We have more games coming up right here in the Hub, and if we keep playing like this, the wild card hunt is gonna get very interesting down the stretch. I am just enjoying the ride while the bats are this hot, because we all know that in this town, the mood can shift faster than the traffic on the Pike.

news_digest.headline: Rutschman hits 1st homer for Red Sox as Boston beats the Diamondbacks 9-4
news_digest.dans_take: Finally, a big night from the new guy that shows he belongs in this lineup and isn't just here for the scenery.

trend_watch.trend: Hit his first home run as a Red Sox player
trend_watch.dans_take: About damn time he connected for a big one, he looked so comfortable at the plate I thought he was hitting off a tee.

trend_watch.trend: Earned his first win since late June
trend_watch.dans_take: He looked like a different guy on the mound and if he keeps that poise, I might actually stop pacing during his starts.

trend_watch.trend: Pitched a scoreless inning in relief
trend_watch.dans_take: The bullpen is finally looking like they have their heads on straight and I love to see it, no cardiac events required.
